title: Recorded route output incorrectly blocks a valid ask
detail: The real steps CLI rejects an exact Observed fence containing GET /health 200 with message S4: missing path /health. The same false hold reaches question through either gate text or the latest validation report.
fix: Route through implementation feedback: exclude recognized observation fences from path validation while retaining checks for requested files.

fields.user_workflow: FO prepares an ordinary validation message showing a step beside its captured output, as required by the Captain steps rule.
fields.harm: A completed step and passing observation cannot be presented; gate preparation exits 1 with no missing requested file.
fields.boundary: value-ac[AC-6]: a step FO ran itself, shown with its observed output, passes; contract[kc-dev-flow-2/references/sd/workflow.md#captain-steps]: show each step beside observed output.
fields.trigger: probes/observed-route.log; probes/gate-question.log; probes/gate-report.log; controls pass when the output is moved into a named card or removed.

title: RoboRev 1419 finding 1 needs a Captain waiver
priority: Reviewer High maps to P1; no substantive P1 in accepted scope
detail: The prose omission reproduces but is explicitly excluded by Design / PRFAQ. Recommend accepting that limit, not implementing a new structured message format. High is RoboRev's highest severity; ADR 0004 still requires a recorded Captain waiver.

fields.user_workflow: FO sends an unrecorded prose instruction alongside a recorded harmless sentence.
fields.harm: The prose instruction can be untried and undetected; residual harm is real.
fields.boundary: none: Design / PRFAQ explicitly excludes prose without a command, link or file unless recorded; this is outside the promised detector.
fields.trigger: probes/prose.log and primary stored review roborev-1419.json.

title: Follow-up dispatch shortens the required completion line
detail: Even the candidate checker exits 1 on this follow-up. Its Scope notes omit the canonical suffix beginning End your turn with the Done line below. FO owns the record and correction; validation did not rewrite history.
